query:
UPDATE crm_contacts ct
            SET name = $3
            WHERE ct.id = $1
              AND ct.team_id = $2
              AND ($4 OR (
                  ct.hidden = FALSE
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM crm_companies co
                      WHERE co.id = ct.company_id AND co.hidden
                  )
              ))
            RETURNING ct.id
